contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)

An Early Medieval silver penny of Cnut (AD1016-1035), dating AD1024-1030. North no. 787. The coin is fragmentary but almost 100% remains so it is possible to identify. The coins is of the pointed helmet variety, with a bust facing left wearing a pointed hat and sceptre in front. The inscription reads CNVT / [R]EX ANL.
